title: Loot table
description: What a roll can give (#90). A species table's blank entry rolls again on the instance's table; an instance, chest or tile table has no blank. Chances are thousandths and add up to 1000 (100 %). One file per table, named after its id.

item_entry.description: An item, in an amount rolled from min to max.

blank_entry.description: The blank: a roll on the instance's table instead.

id.description: Stable, never reused: lowercase words joined by underscores.

kind.description: A species table (rolled when a monster is dominated, #86), an instance table (a blank's second roll and loot on the ground, #203), a chest table (what an instance's chests hold, #124, #694: crafting supplies and basic gear) or a tile table (what a harvested tile drops, #696, named in its tile blueprint).
